column1: # Per-RVA extent overrides for the C4 match gate (re/tools/c4_reclass.py, C4R-AC80-EXTENT 2026-11-07).
# A row here makes the gate score a function whose Ghidra body (re/console/pc_funcs.csv body_size) is several
# compiled symbols as the concatenation of those members. members = comma-separated `<sym>@<rva8>:<size>`; size is
# the Ghidra body range the member covers (score_function size). The first member is the row's own `// MATCH:`
# symbol; every other member is a `// HIDDEN: 0x<rva> <sym> <size>` function of the same source. The gate refuses
# unless the sizes sum to pc_funcs body_size, every member is insn 100% at its size, whole-symbol BYTE-IDENTICAL and
# relocheck OK. evidence = the RESULT that proved the extent from the binary (Ghidra body ranges + bytes).
